Class ScenarioThermodynamicAutocalc

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioThermodynamicAutocalc
public final class ScenarioThermodynamicAutocalc extends Object
Historical thermodynamics, metabolic scaling, and per-capita civilizational capacity analytical estimators.

Provides $O(1)$ analytical scaling functions mapping historical chronological years ($t \in [-100\,000, +2\,100]$) to baseline socioeconomic stocks per capita:

  • Capital stock per capita: $K_0(t)$ [$\text{kg/hab}$ or $\text{1990 Int. \$ per capita}$]
  • Exergy / energy throughput per capita: $E_0(t)$ [$\text{MJ/hab/year}$]
  • Food security reserves: $F_0(t)$ [$\text{months of autarkic caloric supply}$]
  • Information density: $I_0(t)$ [$\text{bits/hab}$]
Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

  • Method Details

    • computeAutoCapitalFromYear

      public static double computeAutoCapitalFromYear(long year)
      Computes the canonical physical capital stock per capita $K_0$ as a function of start year.

      Empirical scaling derived from archaeological material culture estimates and Maddison Project: \begin{equation} K_0(t) = \begin{cases} 1.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } t \le -50\,000 \\ 5.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } -50\,000 invalid input: '<' t \le -10\,000 \\ 25.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } -10\,000 invalid input: '<' t \le -3\,000 \\ 100.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } -3\,000 invalid input: '<' t \le -500 \\ 200.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } -500 invalid input: '<' t \le 1\,000 \\ 500.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } 1\,000 invalid input: '<' t \le 1\,500 \\ 2\,500.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } 1\,500 invalid input: '<' t \le 1\,800 \\ 8\,000.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } 1\,800 invalid input: '<' t \le 1\,950 \\ 15\,000.0\,\text{kg/hab} invalid input: '&' \text{if } t > 1\,950 \end{cases} \end{equation}

      Parameters:
      year - the simulation start year $t$ in years CE/BCE
      Returns:
      capital stock $K_0$ in kg/capita equivalent

    • computeAutoEnergyFromYear

      public static double computeAutoEnergyFromYear(long year)
      Computes the baseline exergy and energy throughput per capita $E_0$ as a function of start year.

      Exergy values based on Vaclav Smil's historical energy transition data: \begin{equation} E_0(t) \in [10.0, 50\,000.0]\,\text{MJ/hab} \end{equation}

      Parameters:
      year - the simulation start year $t$ in years CE/BCE
      Returns:
      energy throughput $E_0$ in MJ/capita
